SELECT m.id, m.name, lc.login_id, m.phone, m.status, mp.name as membership_name, DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_days, t.name AS trainer_name, latest_attendance.last_attendance_at FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN user_local_credentials lc ON lc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = ( SELECT mm2.id FROM member_memberships mm2 WHERE mm2.member_id = m.id AND mm2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm2.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm2.end_date ASC, mm2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id LEFT JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.id = ( SELECT ta2.id FROM trainer_assignments ta2 WHERE ta2.member_id = m.id AND ta2.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ta2.started_at DESC, ta2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(checked_in_at) AS last_attendance_at FROM attendances GROUP BY member_id ) latest_attendance ON latest_attendance.member_id = m.id
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR lc.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND m.status = #{status}
AND mm.id IS NOT NULL
AND mm.id IS NOT NULL AND mm.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND mm.id IS NULL
ORDER BY m.id DESC
